plugins.name: events-tracker-shared
plugins.description: Base map, ontology, invariants, and Linear MCP-tool guide for the Events tracker. Bundles the Linear MCP server. Auto-loaded as a dependency of any events-tracker-* role plugin — not installed directly.

plugins.name: events-tracker-pm
plugins.description: PM / tracker-owner role for the Events tracker (Linear ENG + DES). Project pair creation, Triage sweep, cycle planning. Depends on events-tracker-shared.

plugins.name: events-tracker-designer
plugins.description: Designer role for the Events tracker (Linear DES + ENG). Self-pull Design Issues, submit for dev review, respond to bounces, review impl on staging in Design Review. Depends on events-tracker-shared.

plugins.name: events-tracker-dev
plugins.description: Developer role for the Events tracker (Linear ENG + DES). Pick up Impl Issues, walk In Progress → In Review → In Staging, hand off to Design Review / QA, respond to bounces. Depends on events-tracker-shared.

plugins.name: events-tracker-qa
plugins.description: QA role for the Events tracker (Linear ENG). Pick up Impl Issues in QA status, approve to Done or reject with a checklist. Depends on events-tracker-shared.

plugins.name: events-tracker-public
plugins.description: Stakeholder-facing Events tracker access for people outside the dev team — read ENG + DES read-only, file requests into ENG Triage. Standalone; does not use events-tracker-shared.
